name_zh: WQ101 Alpha10 条件价格变化排名
formula_zh: rank(按4期价格变化极值选择同向或反向的一期收盘变化)
intuition_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 5h bars.

expected_direction_explanation_en: Direction intentionally left conditional to avoid post-hoc fitting. Empirical diagnostics required.

known_limitations_en: Conditional close-delta rank uses hard trend-state branches and can flip in choppy markets.

horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 5 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
